{{Quote|The alterations that Darth Malora has inflicted on her Geonosians are unconscionable! I sincerely hope to correct them. |Doctor Tramulek|<ref name="scienceodark" />}}
'''Tramulek''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who lived near the farmsteads on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]]. He worked on a [[Geonosian Serum|serum]] to reverse [[Darth Malora]]'s [[Mutated Geonosian|modifications]] of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]]. Tramulek was not able to cure the mutated Geonosians but his serum was specifically formulated to pacify them.<ref name="scienceodark" />
